name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of Conjuring) — 2 Intermediate — Reverse Conjuration

system.description:
With a few words and a simple gesture, the thaumaturge banishes conjured matter back to the nether planes from which it was drawn.

To dispel an item you can see or feel, make a Mental Challenge against the Traits recorded at that item's creation. This works only on conjured objects, and you have no special way of telling a conjured item from a real one. You may banish any of your own creations without a challenge, though it still takes a full turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
